fields.name: Player
fields.evidence: EoCClient.dll+0x5ABC00 UpdateMessageBoxes sets it to the local player id returned by the IDropInApprovalHelper slot 8, or 1.

fields.name: IsOwnRequest
fields.evidence: Set to (host info user == local player id).

fields.name: RequestId
fields.evidence: Assigned from the FixedString request id of the drop-in notification (same key as AttemptsToJoinSingletonComponent).

fields.name: Text
fields.evidence: Assigned from the ToApproveInfoHost name STDString (empty for cancel/close requests).

fields.name: Type
fields.evidence: Value byte of an optional: bg3.exe+0x1AD5CE0 (~UpdateMessageBoxes) stores the 16-bit word 0x111 (approval prompt) or 0x112 (other notice) at +0x20 = value 0x11/0x12 + has-flag 1; the close-request branch leaves it empty. Probably the message box kind.

fields.name: HasType
fields.evidence: has-value flag of the optional at +0x20 (high byte of the 0x111/0x112 word)

fields.name: _Pad22
fields.evidence: padding to the element stride 0x28 (bg3.exe+0x1AD5CE0 appends at index*0x28)

fields.name: OpenRequests
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0x5ABC00 ecl::multiplayer::DropInApprovalSystem::UpdateMessageBoxes clears the array at +0 (size +0xC) each frame and appends requests (FUN_1805A8730(component, &request)) for new approval prompts (type 0x11) and other notices (0x12).

fields.name: CloseRequests
fields.evidence: Same function clears the array at +0x10 (size +0x1C) and appends requests of the same struct (FUN_1805A8730(component+0x10, ...)) for canceled requests (Player = 1, RequestId set, no Type). macOS default: zeroed 32 bytes; live: empty.

open_questions: Names Open/Close are inferred from which notifications feed them (approval request vs canceled request).
second_pass: Confirmed on Windows: bg3.exe+0x1AD5CE0 (~UpdateMessageBoxes) appends to the arrays at +0 and +0x10 with element stride 0x28 and writes int16 +0, byte +2, FixedString +4, STDString +8 and the 16-bit optional word at +0x20; creator bg3.exe+0x1AD76C0 allocates and zeroes 0x20 bytes. The std::optional<uint8_t> of the first version is now a value byte plus a flag byte (build types only).
live_reason: only empty (all-zero) instances were seen: the member boundaries are untested
